_comment: IAM policy definitions for the Quito Transport Platform. Each policy follows least-privilege: only the permissions required by each component are granted.

lambda_ingestion_policy.description: Allows Lambda ingestion functions to write Parquet files to the S3 raw zone and read secrets from Secrets Manager.

glue_processing_policy.description: Allows Glue jobs to read from the S3 raw zone, write to the processed zone, and update the Glue Data Catalog.

airflow_orchestration_policy.description: Allows MWAA (Airflow) to trigger Lambda, start Glue jobs, and write logs to CloudWatch.

redshift_load_policy.description: Allows Redshift to COPY data from the S3 processed zone.

metabase_readonly_policy.description: Read-only Redshift role for Metabase EC2 instance.
